description: Open a new Ripey store for the user. Ask for the store name and the user's email first. Optionally takes the user's Solana wallet address (public address only, never a secret key); in test mode a demo address is used if omitted. Returns the store URL, a private dashboard link, and an agent_key: pass it to the other Ripey tools on this same connection to manage the store.

wallet.description: Optional Solana public address where sales are paid

name: open_store
title: Open a Ripey store
